author.name_ar: أبو عبد الله سفيان بن سعيد بن مسروق الثوري الكوفي

structureNote: Rows 1 to 38 are the modern editor's introduction; row 280 is the editor's conclusion. Surah sections follow the 49 headings printed in the Arabic, from al-Baqara to al-Tur.

translation.conventions: English translation of the Arabic text of Tafsir al-Thawri (Shamela book 2229). Page numbering, ordering, and entry numbers follow the source. Passages the source Arabic renders unintelligibly are marked in square brackets.
